card.name: Words just before a mixing partner
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, and, of, or a noun right after a drug name or contact/mixing phrase, where the next words name another substance it should not be combined with. Mostly in compatibility and mixing instructions.

modes.example: Do not mix ELLENCE<< with>> heparin or fluorouracil

modes.description: Linking word after contact or mixed, before the other substance.
modes.example: Ceftriaxone for injection is mixed<< with>> calcium-containing solutions in the same IV administration

modes.label: Mentions of taking another drug
modes.description: A noun such as patient or iron that leads into a second drug or substance.
